en.answer: Providing that that face-down Defense Position Synchro Monster is flipped face-up by battle and is destroyed by that battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can activate <<8529>>.
en.question: If a monster you control attacks a face-down Defense Position Synchro Monster the opponent controls and that Synchro Monster flipped face-up by that battle is destroyed in battle and sent to the Graveyard, can you activate <<8529>> during that turn?
